{{Quote|How long would our return to Coruscant be delayed if we stopped at Foless?''"<br />"''Maybe an hour or so&hellip;''"<br />"''Very well. Inform the others we'll be taking these civilians to Foless.|[[Nuru Kungurama]] and [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]]|<ref name="SA" />}}
The '''Foless system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Southern Core]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the periphery of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Foless/Legends|Foless]].<ref name="SA" />

The Foless system sat at the intersection of the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]],<ref name="FaDCR" /> known as the [[Foless Crossroads/Legends|Foless Crossroads]].<ref name="SoL" /><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|284|Foless Crossroads}}</ref>

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The appendix to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] both placed the Foless system in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EAOC" /> However, the Foless system was shown to be in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region on the maps of ''The Essential Atlas''.<ref name="TEA" /> This error was repeated in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'',<ref name="TEGtW" /> and also in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s core rulebooks for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series.<ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="AoR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="FaDCR" />

{{System-stub}}
